basic_info.description: Brimming with character and light, this spacious 991 sq. ft. one-bed condo blends classic 1930s Spanish Mediterranean details with modern updates. A cove entry leads to an airy, open formal dining and living room framed by floor-to-ceiling windows, flanked with built-in bookshelves, and perfect for entertaining. Just off the living room, an alcove with a built-in desk creates the ideal work-from-home space. The updated kitchen shines with Carrara marble counters and backsplash, s/s appliances, and a window over the sink. The spacious bedroom easily fits a king-size bed and has a large walk-in closet. The bathroom offers both a separate soaking tub and a walk-in shower, along with a pedestal sink. Throughout, you'll find arched entries, crown molding, picture rails, crystal doorknobs and warm oak hardwood floors that add to the ambiance.  Additional highlights include, plentiful in-unit storage, shared laundry w/ potential for in-unit installation, garage parking, and roof access with breathtaking GG bridge views. Marina Green, Crissy Field, Fort Mason, and the shops and cafes of Chestnut and Union Streets are right outside your door. An exceptional opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhood, where coastal beauty meets city energy.
